title: Open-square comparison counit equation on K-injective representatives
statement: Let $s:Y\to S$, $r:T\to S$ be scheme morphisms and $B\subseteq Y$ open [def-pc-scheme]. Assume common-universe derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] on every scheme. Put $P=Y\times_S T$, $P_B=B\times_S T$, $\pi:P\to Y$, $\pi_B:P_B\to B$ and $b:P_B\to P$. Derive the ordinary module mate [lem-pc-perfect-hom-open-module-mate] via rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso, rightDerivedFunctorNatIso, rightDerivedFunctorCompIso, rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory, then identify exact restriction along b with Lb* by conjugateIsoEquiv for the pinned pullback adjunction [def-pc-affine-global-hom-base-change-map]. Call this explicitly constructed isomorphism beta-zero. Use the pinned canonicalPullbackAdjunction for B, pi and pi_B. Let sigma be the conjugate of the right-adjoint identity between the canonical open adjunction and schemeMVAdjunction. Define kappa from perfectHomComposition b pi, transport of b pi = pi_B B, inverse perfectHomComposition pi_B B, and sigma inverse whiskered by Lpi_B* [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. For any K-injective complex I on P [def-pur-kinjective-complex], Lpi_B*(beta-zero at QI) followed by the canonical pi_B counit at Lb*(QI) equals kappa inverse at Rpi_*(QI) followed by Lb* of the canonical pi counit at QI. This is an equality of maps, not an invertibility assertion about a mate.

proof.text: Use normalizedDirectImageSquare_unit to identify the fixed derived right-adjoint square by its pasted unit equation. Apply exactMateComparison_eq to the ordinary open module mate. Exactness and preservation of K-injectives are supplied by the existing open restriction constructions.

The existing derivedDirectImage_square_mate identifies this right-adjoint square with the conjugate of the fixed pullback-composition square. Transport the two open adjunctions by conjugateIsoEquiv and use iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv and mateEquiv_counit. Naturality of the counit and the open-adjunction transport cancel the inverse conjugations. Expand the explicit derived comparison and the inverse κ component; this gives the unchanged counit equation at Q(I).

lean.statement:
theorem perfectHomOpenComparison_counit_resolution
    {S Y T : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ S) (B : Y.Opens) (r : T ⟶ S)
    (I : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback s r).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    let a := canonicalPullbackAdjunction B.ι
    let ap := canonicalPullbackAdjunction (pullback.fst s r)
    let ap' := canonicalPullbackAdjunction (pullback.fst (B.ι ≫ s) r)
    let b := perfectHomOpenMap s B r
    let σ : schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B ≅ derivedPullback B.ι :=
      (conjugateIsoEquiv a (schemeMVAdjunction Y B)).symm (Iso.refl _)
    let he : b ≫ pullback.fst s r = pullback.fst (B.ι ≫ s) r ≫ B.ι := by
      simp [b, perfectHomOpenMap, pullback.map]
    let κ := perfectHomComposition b (pullback.fst s r) ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ derivedPullback f) he) ≪≫
      (perfectHomComposition (pullback.fst (B.ι ≫ s) r) B.ι).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight σ.symm (derivedPullback (pullback.fst (B.ι ≫ s) r))
    (derivedPullback (pullback.fst (B.ι ≫ s) r)).map
        ((perfectHomOpenDerivedComparison s B r).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫
        ap'.counit.app ((derivedPullback b).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) =
      κ.inv.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.fst s r)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫
        (derivedPullback b).map (ap.counit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))
